query_reviews.note: 连续产量+0-1启停=MIP。宽松LP已移除以保证primary纯度；QP为可信HN。
Continuous+binary setup=MIP. LP removed as spurious acceptable; QP is credible HN.
最小站点覆盖服务半径=Covering Models；IP作二值规划形式合理；MST为可信HN。
Set covering over service radius=Covering Models; IP as equivalent binary formulation correct; MST credible HN.
恰好访问一次+最短回路=TSP；Hamiltonian Cycle作可行结构补充合理；Shortest Path为可信HN。
Min-cost tour all vertices=TSP; Hamiltonian cycle as structural companion correct; Shortest Path credible HN.
传感器连通+可选中继点=Steiner Tree。MST已移除（虽为基线但查询聚焦专属问题）；Matching为可信HN。
Terminals+optional relays=Steiner Tree. MST removed; Matching credible HN.
多仓库调货+容量费用=Network Flow；LP作流守恒线性表述合理；Matching为可信HN。
Capacitated min-cost flow=Network Flow; LP as flow-conservation formulation correct; Matching credible HN.
随机到达+等待拥堵=Queuing Theory。Decision Theory已移除；Inventory为可信HN。
Random arrivals+congestion=Queuing Theory. Decision Theory removed; Inventory credible HN.
不确定需求+多期订货=Inventory Theory；DP作状态递推合理；Queuing为可信HN。
Uncertain demand+multi-period ordering=Inventory Theory; DP as sequential recursion correct; Queuing credible HN.
有限健康状态+动作改变转移概率=MDP；DP作Bellman递推合理；Difference Equation为可信HN。
Action-dependent stochastic transitions=MDP; DP as Bellman recursion correct; Difference Equation credible HN.
多目标不能合并固定权重=Multi-Objective Programming。Goal Programming已移除；TOPSIS为可信HN。
Multiple objectives without fixed weighting=Multi-Objective Programming. Goal Programming removed; TOPSIS credible HN.
先定批发价后确定货量=Multi-level Programming。Decision Theory已移除；AHP为可信HN。
Leader-follower sequential=Multi-level Programming. Decision Theory removed; AHP credible HN.
光滑非线性+等式不等式约束+必要条件=KKT Conditions。Lagrange Multiplier已移除（KKT涵盖）；Newton为可信HN。
Necessary conditions for smooth constrained=KKT. Lagrange Multiplier removed; Newton credible HN.
0-1变量+可证明全局最优+剪枝=Branch and Bound；Relaxation提供边界合理；GA为可信HN。
Binary variables+provable optimum+bound pruning=B&B; Relaxation for bounds correct; GA credible HN.
记忆近期动作+越过局部最优=Tabu Search；SA作概率跳出替代合理；Greedy为可信HN。
Move memory+escape local optima=Tabu Search; SA as probabilistic escape correct; Greedy credible HN.
无梯度+并行群体+共享历史最优=PSO；GA作群体进化替代合理；Conjugate Gradient为可信HN。
Derivative-free+parallel population+shared best=PSO; GA as population alternative correct; Conjugate Gradient credible HN.
缺失噪声+非线性+缩放不敏感+多弱模型=Random Forest；Boosting作串行集成替代合理；Naive Bayes为可信HN。
Scale-insensitive+weak learners+nonlinear=Random Forest; Boosting as sequential ensemble correct; Naive Bayes credible HN.
少样本高维+少量关键样本+宽分隔带=SVM；共享协方差+高斯分布=LDA。查询改写后两方法描述精准且无泄露；Naive Bayes为可信HN。
Scarce labels+critical samples+widest separation+shared covariance=SVM+LDA. Rewritten query descriptive and unleaked; Naive Bayes credible HN.
已知K+紧凑球形+可扩展中心=K-Means；EM作软分配替代合理；Hierarchical为可信HN。
Known-k+compact spherical+scalable centroids=K-Means; EM as soft-assignment correct; Hierarchical credible HN.
高维→二维网格+保留邻域拓扑=SOM；Hierarchical作嵌套结构补充合理；K-Means为可信HN。
2D grid+topology-preserving=SOM; Hierarchical as nested structure correct; K-Means credible HN.
高度共线+近似线性+稳定系数=Ridge；Linear Regression作无正则基线合理；Poisson为可信HN。
Collinear+approximately linear+stabilize=Ridge; Linear Regression as baseline correct; Poisson credible HN.
缓慢变化+无全局函数+附近样本拟合=LWLR。Linear Regression已移除（全局线在纯局部场景为弱基线）；Ridge为可信HN。
Smoothly varying+local trends=LWLR. Linear Regression removed; Ridge credible HN.
两组高维+最强共同变化+压缩维度=CCA。PCA已移除并转为HN（单组方差最大化≠跨组共享变异）；LLE同为可信HN。
Two views+shared variation+dimension reduction=CCA. PCA moved to HN; LLE also credible HN.
弯曲低维流形+局部邻域重构=LLE；Laplacian Eigenmaps作图谱替代合理；PCA为可信HN。
Curved manifold+local reconstruction=LLE; Laplacian Eigenmaps as graph-spectrum correct; PCA credible HN.
自助样本+并行训练+平均=Bagging；Random Forest作特征随机化精炼合理；Boosting为可信HN。
Bootstrap+parallel+average=Bagging; Random Forest as feature-randomized correct; Boosting credible HN.
非平稳趋势+自相关+差分后预测+离散递推=ARIMA。查询改写更精准（去季节性保留非平稳）；Difference Equation作递推表示合理；Grey为可信HN。
Nonstationary trend+autocorrelation+differencing=ARIMA. Refined query; Difference Equation correct; Grey credible HN.
均值稳定+波动成簇+条件方差=GARCH。ARIMA已移除（均值稳定则均值建模非必需）；Grey为可信HN。
Volatility clustering+conditional variance=GARCH. ARIMA removed; Grey credible HN.
人群分舱+传播参数+干预策略=Infectious Disease Model。MDP已移除；Population Prediction为可信HN。
Compartments+transmission+staged interventions=Infectious Disease Model. MDP removed; Population Prediction credible HN.
河流输运扩散+上游排放+衰减离散求解=River Pollutant Diffusion；Difference Equation作有限差分离散合理；Heat Conduction为可信HN。
Advection-diffusion+decay+discrete solver=River Pollutant Diffusion; Difference Equation correct; Heat Conduction credible HN.
两两比较+一致性检查+正负理想排序=AHP+TOPSIS；Entropy Weighting为可信HN。
Pairwise comparison+consistency+ideal solution ranking=AHP+TOPSIS; Entropy Weighting credible HN.
不采用专家+离散度客观权重+理想距离排序=Entropy Weighting+TOPSIS；AHP为可信HN。
No expert+indicator dispersion+ideal distance=Entropy Weighting+TOPSIS; AHP credible HN.
模糊语言评价+隶属度综合=Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation；AHP作专家权重输入合理；DEA为可信HN。
Fuzzy linguistic ratings+membership=Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation; AHP for expert weights correct; DEA credible HN.
准则依赖反馈+网络结构优先权=ANP；AHP作独立层次基线合理；TOPSIS为可信HN。
Dependence+feedback+network priorities=ANP; AHP as independence baseline correct; TOPSIS credible HN.
多投入多产出+效率前沿+相对低效程度=DEA。查询改写聚焦前沿识别；TOPSIS已移除；ANOVA为可信HN。
Multiple I/O+efficiency frontier+relative inefficiency=DEA. Refined query; TOPSIS removed; ANOVA credible HN.
近似正态+近似直线+检验线性相关=Pearson；Linear Regression作预测直线补充合理；Kendall为可信HN。
Approximately normal+linear scatter=Pearson; Linear Regression for predictive line correct; Kendall credible HN.
配对差值近似对称非正态+参数预先给定正态参考分布比较+配对位置改变=Wilcoxon+KS Test。查询改写更精准；ANOVA为可信HN。
Paired non-normal differences+specified normal reference+paired shift=Wilcoxon+KS Test. Refined query; ANOVA credible HN.
四种工艺+均值比较+残差分布吻合=ANOVA+KS Test；Wilcoxon为可信HN。
Four groups+mean comparison+residual distribution=ANOVA+KS Test; Wilcoxon credible HN.
分类变量计数比例+连续分布吻合=Chi-Square GOF+KS Test；ANOVA为可信HN。
Categorical counts/proportions+continuous distribution=Chi-Square GOF+KS Test; ANOVA credible HN.
年度年龄组+出生死亡迁移+政策情景递推=Population Prediction；Difference Equation作递推表示合理；Infectious Disease为可信HN。
Cohort projection+births+deaths+migration=Population Prediction; Difference Equation correct; Infectious Disease credible HN.
资本劳动技术+长期产出+储蓄率增长情景=Economic Growth Model；Difference Equation作资本更新递推合理；Population Prediction为可信HN。
Capital+labour+technology+growth scenarios=Economic Growth; Difference Equation correct; Population Prediction credible HN.
细长材料两端温度+时空导数离散=Heat Conduction；Difference Equation作有限差分合理；River Pollutant Diffusion为可信HN。
Transient conductive heat+discretized derivatives=Heat Conduction; Difference Equation correct; River Pollutant credible HN.
双方兵力消耗+分阶段调整+最终损失=Battle Model；DP作确定性多阶段递推合理（MDP已替换）；Infectious Disease为可信HN。
Two-force attrition+staged adjustments+final losses=Battle Model; DP as deterministic multi-stage formulation correct; Infectious Disease credible HN.

equivalence_reviews.note: method-0与method-38均为Linear Programming语义重复条目，应合并为一个Retrieval概念。
method-89与method-90描述几乎逐字相同，均通过信息熵确定客观权重，应合并。
